description: GTEx v10 gene-level eGene/sGene summary, keyed by Ensembl gene (ENSG). One entry per gene holds its per-tissue eQTL/sQTL call (is_egene, qval, lead variant, slope). Reachable as ensembl >> gtex_egene. Hand-crafted fixture (tests/datasets/gtex_egene/gtex_egene_fixture.tsv), NOT real GTEx data.

genes.note: 3 tissue rows; 2 are significant eGene/sGene (both Whole_Blood), Lung eQTL below threshold
